description: Defines the Drupal entity class 'ShortcutSet' for managing shortcut set configurations, including methods for saving, deleting, resetting link weights, and retrieving shortcuts.

classes.name: ShortcutSet
classes.description: A Drupal configuration entity class representing a set of shortcuts, with methods for managing shortcuts and their properties.

methods.name: postSave
methods.description: Handles actions after saving a ShortcutSet, including copying shortcuts from the default set if not updating.

methods.name: preDelete
methods.description: Pre-deletion cleanup, removing associated shortcut sets and shortcuts.

methods.name: resetLinkWeights
methods.description: Resets the weights of shortcuts within the set to default order.

methods.name: getShortcuts
methods.description: Retrieves all shortcuts associated with this set, sorted by weight.
